sourceAnchors.exactText: A person adds clients by name. A person adds projects under a client. Each project has an hourly rate in pounds and a billable flag. The project picker on [time-today](../time-today/time-today.spec.md) lists these projects grouped by client, in place of the fixed short list. When there are no projects yet, the picker offers Admin, Client work and Internal under a client called Eggs. Today's total also shows the billable amount: billable hours times each project's rate. A project can be archived, which hides it from the picker but keeps its entries.
